title.en: Only the order of change shows

statement.zh: 插入或移除空步不改变一步的规律、段上的总量与计数以及复现；每步所计的（速率、储备承载多久）相对于读法的单位。
statement.en: Inserting or removing idle steps leaves the laws of one step, the totals and counts over a stretch, and recurrence unchanged; what is counted per step, rates and how long a reserve carries, is relative to the unit of the reading.

claim.zh: 一个停顿（Stutter ρ）指 ρ 0 = 0，每步或空（ρ (n+1) = ρ n）或前进一步，且每步都被到达；经 ρ 读用 Sampling 的 sample。空步上没有参与：平衡、耗散与封闭在每个家族上成立，存量耗减在持有所立者的家族上成立（Flow.sample_idle_balancesOn 等）；前进步上各自恰在所读之步上成立时成立（Flow.sample_moves_balancesOn_iff 等）。所以经停顿读的世界恰在原世界满足前提时满足它们（World.stutter_premises_iff）：平衡（每步每个关系项列出一次）、耗散、只有活跃者给予、只有活跃者取用、活动需要支持、体现与有界的传递；与较粗的读法不同，不需要关于活动如何保持的条件。任何段上的总量就是所读之段的总量（stutter_total；Flow.stutter_taken、Flow.stutter_given、stutter_risen、stutter_fallen、stutter_rise_count、stutter_fall_count，以及在已定之处的 stutter_comings、stutter_ceasings）；生起、止息与立的变化恰在原来复现时复现（World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff、World.stutter_ceasingRecurs_iff、World.stutter_change_recurs_iff）；普查经停顿保留（World.sample_counted），给出每个原步的读法之步时返回（World.stutter_counted_of_section）。停顿改变的是每步所计的：空步出现得任意晚时，没有流无终地更多（Flow.sample_not_more）；扩张无终地更多，每步读两次则不然（Expansion.more_step_relative）；由一份储备承载的世界在每步读两次时需要至少两份（Lapse.reserve_step_relative）。移除空步是一个构造：给出读每个原步的移动之步（Stutter.Moves；每个都存在，Stutter.crosses，且唯一，Stutter.moving_unique），且世界的空步中无参与者、无变动（World.IdleAt），去掉它们的世界（World.withoutIdle）恰在原世界满足每个前提处满足它（World.withoutIdle_premises、World.withoutIdle_transmits），不需要关于列出的条件，因为每步保留自己的交换；恰在原世界有普查处有普查（World.withoutIdle_counted）；在任一段上有相同的所取与所给总量、家族所立的升降及其计数（World.withoutIdle_totals），活动可判定时有相同的生起与止息计数（World.withoutIdle_counts）。不加前提。
claim.en: A stuttering (Stutter ρ) has ρ 0 = 0, each step idle (ρ (n+1) = ρ n) or moving by one, and every step reached; it is read with Sampling's sample. At an idle step nothing takes part: balance, dissipation and closure hold on every family, and running down on a family holding what stands (Flow.sample_idle_balancesOn and others); at a moving step each holds exactly where it holds across the step read (Flow.sample_moves_balancesOn_iff and others). So a world read through a stuttering meets the premises exactly where it meets them (World.stutter_premises_iff): balance (each relatum listed once at each step), dissipation, only active relata giving, only active relata taking, activity needing support, embodiment and bounded transmission; unlike a coarser reading, no condition on how activity is held is needed. Over any stretch the totals are those of the stretch read (stutter_total; Flow.stutter_taken, Flow.stutter_given, stutter_risen, stutter_fallen, stutter_rise_count, stutter_fall_count, and where decided stutter_comings, stutter_ceasings); arising, ceasing and change of standing recur exactly where they recurred (World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_ceasingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_change_recurs_iff); a census survives a stuttering (World.sample_counted) and returns where a step of the reading is given for each step (World.stutter_counted_of_section). What a stuttering changes is what is counted per step: with idle steps arbitrarily late no flow is more without end (Flow.sample_not_more); the expansion is more without end and, every step read twice, it is not (Expansion.more_step_relative); a world carried by a reserve of one needs a reserve of at least two when every step is read twice (Lapse.reserve_step_relative). Removing idle steps is a construction: given for each step read the moving step reading it (Stutter.Moves; each exists, Stutter.crosses, and is unique, Stutter.moving_unique) and the idle steps of the world empty and unmoved (World.IdleAt), the world without them (World.withoutIdle) meets every premise exactly where the world does (World.withoutIdle_premises, World.withoutIdle_transmits), with no condition on listing since each step keeps its own exchange, has a census exactly where it does (World.withoutIdle_counted), and over any stretch has the same totals taken and given, rises and falls of a family's standing and their counts (World.withoutIdle_totals), and where activity is decided the same counts of arising and ceasing (World.withoutIdle_counts). No premise.

hypotheses.zh: 停顿 ρ 是给定的读法；World.withoutIdle 从给定的移动步 σ 构造移除空步的世界，保持结论使用 Stutter.Moves ρ σ 与 World.IdleAt。
hypotheses.en: The stuttering ρ is a given reading; World.withoutIdle constructs the world with idle steps removed from supplied moving steps σ, with preservation proved under Stutter.Moves ρ σ and World.IdleAt.

hypotheses.zh: 插入停顿的取用与给予总量要求每个关系项列出一次；withoutIdle 的移除总量不需要这一条件。生起与止息的计数要求活动已定。
hypotheses.en: The taken and given totals for inserting a stuttering require each relatum listed once; the withoutIdle removal totals require no such condition. Counts of arising and ceasing require activity decided.

hypotheses.zh: 移除空步把每个原步的移动之步作为给定函数 σ（Stutter.Moves）；每个移动步都存在且唯一，但本模块没有从停顿单独构造这个函数。
hypotheses.en: Removing idle steps takes the moving step reading each step as a supplied function σ (Stutter.Moves); each moving step exists and is unique, but this module does not construct that function from the stuttering alone.

correspondence.zh: P78（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：零前提计划把共享的离散步序号列为表示的承诺，像 P69 对出发点那样重新奠基。这里给出 Sampling 的严格递增读法的逆：插入空步。读法（AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用）：对一步的规律、段上的总量与计数以及复现，步序号不携带变化次序以外的东西；空步什么也不显出；每步所计的相对于读法的单位，正如较粗的步。见整合文档 §102。
correspondence.en: P78 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists a shared discrete index of steps among the commitments of the representation, to be re-founded as P69 re-founded the starting point. This gives the converse of Sampling's strictly increasing reading: inserting idle steps. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): for the laws of one step, the totals and counts over a stretch, and recurrence, the step index carries nothing beyond the order of change; an idle step shows nothing; what is counted per step is relative to the unit of the reading, as with coarser steps. See the integration document §102.

detail.zh: 复用 Sampling 的 sample、span 与跨读法之步的一步规律；停顿是它的逆方向。
detail.en: Reuses Sampling's sample, span and the laws of one step across a step of the reading; a stuttering is its converse direction.

output.en: Reading a world through a monotone reading.

detail.zh: 一步的规律：经停顿读时不变。
detail.en: The laws of one step: unchanged when read through a stuttering.

detail.zh: 连续时间作为越来越细的离散读法之塔；这里是相反方向：插入空步。
detail.en: Continuous time as a tower of ever-finer discrete readings; here the other direction: inserting idle steps.

detail.zh: 同一模块：相继的独立交换的次序。
detail.en: The same module: the order of consecutive independent exchanges.

detail.zh: 每步读两次时扩张不再无终地更多（Expansion.more_step_relative），储备需要加倍（Lapse.reserve_step_relative）。
detail.en: Read with every step twice, the expansion is no longer more without end (Expansion.more_step_relative), and the reserve must double (Lapse.reserve_step_relative).

limitations.zh: 移除时每个原步的移动之步是给定的（Stutter.Moves）；意义谓词（§6.15 的条件所用者）的不变性没有证明；连续时间没有陈述；读法是 AI 的，依 Ren 的交托采用；不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: The moving step for each step read is supplied for the removal (Stutter.Moves); invariance of the significance predicates (those the condition of section 6.15 uses) is not shown; continuous time is not stated; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation; no ethical predicate occurs.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器成功实查（20261013T094743.528770Z）：Becoming.Order 的 266 项定理全部空依赖，其中含 Stutter、World.stutter_premises_iff、stutter_total、World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff、World.stutter_counted、Flow.sample_not_more、Expansion.more_step_relative、Lapse.reserve_step_relative、World.withoutIdle、World.IdleAt、Stutter.Moves、Stutter.moving_unique、World.withoutIdle_premises、World.withoutIdle_transmits、World.withoutIdle_counted、World.withoutIdle_totals与 World.withoutIdle_counts；同一回执覆盖包内 75 个模块（含只作导入的根模块与桥接），共 4518 项定理／6370 项声明审计，22 个继承模块的当前字节与已通过回执一致；外围回执 20261013T095049.338744Z 通过。检查器另核对核心纯净：核心（GenerativeCore、InquirySufficiency、RelationalRenewal、L1–L4 与根模块 Becoming）的导入闭包恰为这 77 个模块，其中每条源声明的公理报告为空（Lean 生成的常量中，只有带字段构造子的单射引理 injEq 依赖 propext，没有源声明使用它们，检查器逐一列出），并且只用 Lean 内置前导即可编译（基础模块的 import Std 在该次编译中去掉）。作者反审见整合文档 §102；尚无独立审查。
validation_scope.en: Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 266 theorems of Becoming.Order all have empty axiom reports, among them Stutter, World.stutter_premises_iff, stutter_total, World.stutter_arisingRecurs_iff, World.stutter_counted, Flow.sample_not_more, Expansion.more_step_relative, Lapse.reserve_step_relative, World.withoutIdle, World.IdleAt, Stutter.Moves, Stutter.moving_unique, World.withoutIdle_premises, World.withoutIdle_transmits, World.withoutIdle_counted, World.withoutIdle_totals and World.withoutIdle_counts. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §102 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.
